The Richelot map no longer eagerly enumerates its Fp² root table. A std OnceLock initializes it only for actual degree2 pointwise/reference or fallback evaluation. Validated Fp support only queries real discriminants;enumerating the coordinate axes in the original filtered lexicographic order preserves every canonical first root. The old exhaustive builder remains a test reference. Every base discriminant at17/101 matches exactly,including both polynomial roots,zero/repeated roots and degree0/1/error cache behavior,PCC3f015c. No field,polynomial,Cantor,correspondence,infinity or geometric fallback engine is replaced. [pcc:unverified]

Complete changed check.sh02 passes25native/82reference unit plus five integrations,one pre-existing ignored benchmark,all source guards/formatting/strictClippy. Allsix complete12317-class R0/R1/R2 closed/pointwise domains use separate fresh instances:every production call leaves its cache empty while actual quadratic references initialize theirs. Each direction retains239 lower-degree/12078 quadratic/zero fallback routes,exact outputs,dual2,bijections,paired sums,descent/wrong-model and all prior Phi/Psi/generic/naive/source109/113/geometric controls. PCC3c6362 pins exact final arithmetic hashes matching source01 and complete100487-byte raw→standard-xz11812bytes,raw/archive SHA256/exact roundtrip. [pcc:unverified]

ROOT_TABLE.md/PCC4ce55c equals upstream718425. Bound ordered-list theorem RootTable.first_match_filter/PCC1da835 has a one-theorem zero-trusted local kernel/axiom pass,propext only;actual finite fields,basis/domain and concrete grid equality remain written bridges. Formalization is partial. Final source-linked DOT/SVG/Typst/PDF57769bytes/two inspected pages are pinned5e1f22. Initial formal reserved-token parse failure and the lower-degree no-op candidate are preserved upstream17caa0/325922. Scientific standing remains unsigned;static candidate counts p² versus2p-1 establish no measured stage,pipeline or ECDLP speed ratio. [pcc:unverified]

Depends on #1496 and targets its immediate feature branch research/chained-transfer-successor-norms-20261112 at65aabe34879630ad4d973021fb21307e1d856dc1. This head is25fd0be7cea37cefd298d3ac38b6f863bb9105d5. Parent exact-head focusedCI43136703928 succeeds25/81+five,gate passes/sign skips;full166605-byte decoded log→xz22932/API/check observatione2187d is archived here. Own final-headCI/review remain separate. Feature-base auto-merge is unavailable;integrate bottom-up,then retarget main and rerun actual requirements. Frozen-ledger forks and parent1484 unchanged-C findings remain intact. [pcc:unverified]

ROOT_TABLE_STATUS.md,upstream PR3877 and queue3904 retain the resume state. Next CT27 prepares arbitrary balanced-class replay with the existing second Cantor engine,including explicit infinity correction;the existing independent49-class kernel scope is not broadened before that replay passes. Independent isogeny evaluation/kernel membership,large-prime catalog support and full geometric Lean remain open. Matched cold index-calculus/rho comparisons remain owed after S3/livebudget admission;locked atlas and KB/ecdb limits persist. No benchmark,solver,paid allocation,checkpoint bypass or history rewrite. [pcc:unverified]
